project: Hubei independent COT forecast test-chain release
review_scope: read-only code and metadata audit; no real test or buffer payload opened

ground_truth_provenance.details: Separate truth bundles are required, but source workbook, label-builder, interval contract and source-contact provenance are not bound into the truth manifest.

model_lineage_and_inference_receipt.details: Model-manifest digest is format-checked only; actual checkpoints, normalization, trainer, frozen S/R and inference receipt are not verified.

one_use_ledger.details: Atomic O_EXCL ledger is claimed before payload reads, but ledger path follows caller-supplied split path, so a split copy can create another ledger.

synthetic_fail_closed_contract.details: Synthetic-only gate, truth-prediction separation, file hashes, exact time keys, three stations, three seeds, three arms and common-support checks are present.

frozen_metrics.details: Core metrics and date bootstrap exist; two-day-block sensitivity and planned subgroup reporting are missing, and bootstrap settings are not bound by the receipt.

paper_claim_scope.details: Manuscript reports the FA/FAC/FAP values as validation-only and states no independent test result is available.

historical_audit_currency.details: The earlier same-day audit contains findings superseded by current code; its evaluator digest entry in the tracker was malformed and has been corrected.

next_actions: Implement a release-gated source-traceable independent truth builder and synthetic end-to-end witness.
Bind actual checkpoints, normalizations, trainer and frozen S/R sources by path and SHA; produce inference receipt.
Anchor the one-use ledger to a single canonical release identity and bind dependency hashes.
Implement the predeclared two-day-block sensitivity and freeze bootstrap configuration in the release receipt.
Request a fresh independent audit before any real test/buffer payload access.
